message: スパイな大作戦

name: Synn
message: 「Today's bargains were way too good.」

name: Paqy
message: 「Heh heh heh... Deliberately targeting flash sales to drive retail stores into the red is purely wicked, Demon Lord.」

name: Synn
message: 「Should you really be saying that when you're reaping the benefits too?」

name: Amyrina
message: 「Ah, um...」

name: Synn
message: 「Oh, Amyrina... hello.」

name: Amyrina
message: 「H-Hello. Um... Mr. President.」
Even you call me that.

name: Synn
message: 「Are you out shopping too, Amyrina?」

name: Amyrina
message: 「No... that's not really it, though...」

name: Synn
message: 「Then, out for a walk or something?」

name: Amyrina
message: 「Strolling... I suppose.」

name: Synn
message: 「Huh, is that so.」

name: Amyrina
message: 「You don't think it's strange?」

name: Synn
message: 「Because I know someone who loves doing the exact same thing.」

name: Amyrina
message: 「Could you mean Lolotte?」

name: Synn
message: 「Yeah, that's right.」

name: Amyrina
message: 「Lolotte is full of curiosity, after all. She used to tell me all sorts of things she'd learned about.」

name: Synn
message: 「She doesn't anymore?」

name: Amyrina
message: 「She won't even give me the time of day anymore.\s02」

name: Synn
message: 「I see. So you're exploring so you won't lose to her.」

name: Amyrina
message: 「I-It's not like we're having that kind of contest, though...」

name: Amyrina
message: 「I want to know. More about this world--about this town.」

name: Amyrina
message: 「I want to know more... about this place that Lolotte loves so much.」

name: Synn
message: 「You've only just arrived here yourself, right?」

name: Amyrina
message: 「Y-Yes. That is right.」

name: Synn
message: 「There are lots of places Lolotte likes, so if you don't mind just a few of them, I can show you around?」

name: Amyrina
message: 「Huh... Are you sure?」

name: Synn
message: 「Well, as long as you're okay with the shopping district.」

name: Amyrina
message: 「Yes, please, by all means!」

name: Synn
message: 「Lolotte just pressed herself right up against the shop's glass window, you know. Her face got all squished like this.」

name: Amyrina
message: 「Heehee.」

name: Synn
message: 「And then the line Lolotte came out with was, 'So this is what they call window shopping!!'」

name: Amyrina
message: 「Oh, honestly, Lolotte...」

name: Synn
message: 「Also, on the way home from school, we used to eat pork buns here together with everyone.」

name: Amyrina
message: 「Pork buns... are they?」
Right. Of course she's never eaten one before.

name: Synn
message: 「A-Alright then.」
I tightly gripped my last precious 100-yen coin.

name: Synn
message: 「Kim-san, one pork bun!」
I split the bun I bought in half and handed it to her.

name: Amyrina
message: 「Are you sure?」

name: Synn
message: 「Yeah, it's totally fine. I was just wanting to eat one myself anyway.」

name: Amyrina
message: 「Thank you very much.」

name: Synn
message: 「Well then, before it gets cold, let's dig in!」

name: Synn
message: 「How is it?」

name: Amyrina
message: 「This pork bun. Lolotte used to eat these too, didn't she...」

name: Synn
message: 「Of course she did.」

name: Amyrina
message: 「With this, have I been able to understand even a little of the fun Lolotte spoke of...?」

name: Synn
message: 「Don't think about such complicated things. Eat it while it's hot. It tastes better that way.」

name: Synn
message: 「Lolotte's a glutton, you know. She digs into her food with a huge smile on her face.」

name: Synn
message: 「Naturally, at times like that, she empties her head and focuses all her senses on the taste.」

name: Synn
message: 「And then just one word: 'Delicious!'」

name: Synn
message: 「D-Don't tell me. Do you dislike meat?」

name: Amyrina
message: 「Ah, no. Somehow, my stomach feels full, and it makes me feel happy.」

name: Amyrina
message: 「So this is what Lolotte meant by 'delicious'」

name: Synn
message: 「Exactly!」
It seems I somehow managed to make her happy.

name: Amyrina
message: 「Mr. President...」

name: Synn
message: 「Hm?」

name: Amyrina
message: 「So Lolotte has been spending her days harmoniously with everyone like this.」

name: Synn
message: 「I don't think it's anything worth exaggerating that much.\s02」

name: Amyrina
message: 「It truly looks like fun.」

name: Amyrina
message: 「And yet, I didn't even listen to what Lolotte had to say...」

name: Synn
message: 「Amyrina...?」
Even though I went out of my way to treat her to a meat bun, she grows gloomy and looks down.

name: Synn
message: 「I don't really know what happened between you and Lolotte, but... you two are friends, right?」

name: Synn
message: 「If so, I think it's better to get along and have fun together.」

name: Synn
message: 「Isn't that why you came to see Lolotte in the first place?」

name: Synn
message: 「Isn't it because you want to do that that you're trying to learn about the things Lolotte loves?」

name: Amyrina
message: 「I don't know. However, if doing so will make Lolotte forgive me even a little...」

name: Amyrina
message: 「If there were any room for forgiveness, you wouldn't... avoid me, right...」

name: Synn
message: 「Amyrina...」

name: Amyrina
message: 「Thank you very much for today. The meat bun was delicious.」

name: Amyrina
message: 「Well then, goodbye.」
Leaving behind a frail impression, she disappears back into the city once more.

name: Synn
message: 「Amyrinaaa!!」

name: Synn
message: 「If there's ever anything I can help with, don't hesitate to tell me!」

name: Amyrina
message: 「Mr. President...」

name: Synn
message: 「Well, take care! Bye-bye!」
I hope this cheers her up even a little.
I felt kind of embarrassed, so I immediately looked away from Amyrina.

name: Riesling
message: 「You certainly are caring. I believe I understand why my lady places her trust in you.」

name: Synn
message: 「Huh.」

name: Riesling
message: 「I am currently in the middle of a mission, so please excuse me.」

name: Synn
message: 「Ah, hey, wait!!」
Lolotte isn't even here, so why is Riesling-san...?
